name: Misha Grodny
original_name: ミーシャ・グロドヌイ
source: Misha, Almina's daughter, had a tough time during a rebellion on her summer break from the Royal Academy. With her maid Orié's help, she escaped with her mom to Altani, reuniting after three years. Misha, aspiring to be like her popular mom with silver hair, struggles with fear and shyness. Close to Orié like sisters, she developed feelings for the protagonist, 'Uncle,' who saved them three years ago. Despite her good figure, she feels less confident about her femininity compared to Almina.
